provenance.label: state trajectory

provenance.permitted_interpretation: Committed runtime-state motion within this fixed projection.
provenance.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not infer physical space, semantic distance, consciousness, or physical validation from this view.

provenance.label: Smoothed state
provenance.discarded_information: 2D discards 10 components; 3D discards 9. Projected distances can distort 12D relations.
provenance.permitted_interpretation: Projected separation between current state and its contractive runtime self-model.
provenance.forbidden_extrapolation: Not a measurement of phenomenal self-awareness.

provenance.label: Update direction field
provenance.discarded_information: Orthogonal Update components are hidden. Grid density 45 is a display choice.
provenance.permitted_interpretation: Direction of the declared local update proxy and potential derivative.
provenance.forbidden_extrapolation: A numerical update field in this visualization.

provenance.label: Input forcing
provenance.discarded_information: 2D discards 10 components; 3D discards 9. Projected distances can distort 12D relations.
provenance.permitted_interpretation: The current runtime forcing vector and scalar energy.
provenance.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not infer physical space, semantic distance, consciousness, or physical validation from this view.

provenance.label: Coherence score surface
transform_chain: pure probe evaluation of implementation-local Coherence
provenance.discarded_information: The live engine emits one scalar Coherence per observer; spatial variation is model evaluation, not direct telemetry.
provenance.permitted_interpretation: How the current implementation's Coherence formula changes over the projected slice.
provenance.forbidden_extrapolation: No universal coherence field or threshold is implied.

provenance.label: Declared attractor potential
provenance.discarded_information: Kernel width, event weights, and projection distortions determine the rendered topology.
provenance.permitted_interpretation: A implementation-local diagnostic landscape over declared basins and memory artifacts.
provenance.forbidden_extrapolation: A visualization of declared numerical potential only.

provenance.label: Memory influence applied influence
provenance.discarded_information: Only applied or queued packet endpoints and similarity are shown.
provenance.permitted_interpretation: An actual recall packet contributed to this tick.
provenance.forbidden_extrapolation: Proximity alone is not shown as causal influence.

provenance.label: Basin projection readiness surface
provenance.discarded_information: The contour does not carry temporal dwell history at every probe point.
provenance.permitted_interpretation: Instantaneous readiness in this implementation, with live dwell/hold disclosed separately.
provenance.forbidden_extrapolation: A readiness surface derived from this engine configuration.

provenance.label: Event markers
provenance.discarded_information: 2D discards 10 components; 3D discards 9. Projected distances can distort 12D relations.
provenance.permitted_interpretation: Integrity-bearing runtime events at their projected source states.
provenance.forbidden_extrapolation: An event marker is not evidence of physical branching.

provenance.label: Declared observer coupling
provenance.discarded_information: 2D discards 10 components; 3D discards 9. Projected distances can distort 12D relations.
provenance.permitted_interpretation: A DEVELOP coupling input applied symmetrically from a frozen two-observer snapshot.
provenance.forbidden_extrapolation: A numerical coupling between two simulation instances.
